proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL – PROXY VOTING PRACTICES REGARDING EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION
proposals.proponent: The Stephen M. Silberstein Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board report by December 2016 evaluating options to align BlackRock's proxy voting practices on executive compensation with its stated principle of linking pay and performance.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal
